posts.body:
Hi to the other mums (& dads of course),

I need help before I drive myself mad looking at hundreds more buggies, lol. I need to buy a new pushchair for my 1 year old. The one we currently have we've had since our other little one was 6 months and he's 5 now so its done well but has finally given up on me.

I've been looking around on the internet all day and am driving myself mad reading reviews. I don't mind if the buggy is 3 or 4 wheels the only thing I most definitely want is one with the reclining back that clicks into 3 or 4 different places so the child can sit straight up or lay down etc, not the pull cord type as I've found those completely useless in the past.

Obviously I don't want to spend a fortune but want something that will last her now until I can do away with the pushchair completely (3 year old)? I found some good styles around the £100-120 mark but the reviews are mixed so any advice on what you guys use that you can give me good feedback on would be appreciated please? 

Thank you in advance xx

posts.body:
We have a Silver Cross 'Pop' that we bought for over 8 years ago and is still in almost daily use. It has travelled on planes, still going.

You can fold it with one hand and sling it over your shoulder. When in cafes, I can fold it up and tuck it up under the table.

I think they are about the £120 ish mark.

Hope this helps.
